title: Randomized, Controlled Trial of Regular Sildenafil Citrate in the Prevention of Altitude Illness
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether regular oral use of sildenafil citrate can prevent or attenuate high altitude illnesses.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Participant in Apex 2 high altitude expedition

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previous history of high altitude pulmonary edema
